name: RBI Cyber Security Framework for Banks & NBFCs

controls.name: Board-level Cybersecurity Governance & Cyber Crisis Management
controls.gap_description: Quantified risk metrics (EAL, VaR) provided directly to Risk Management Committee (RMC).

controls.name: Inventory of Authorized and Unauthorized Assets
controls.gap_description: Comprehensive tracking of core banking applications, payment switches, and databases.

controls.name: Multi-Factor Authentication for Privileged Access
controls.gap_description: RBI mandates strict 2FA/MFA for all administrative sessions and critical database access.

controls.name: Network Segmentation and Subnetting
controls.gap_description: Core transaction database (ASSET-003) requires isolated network zone.

controls.name: Vulnerability Remediation & Patching SLAs
controls.gap_description: Critical web vulnerabilities must be remediated within RBI's emergency timeline.

controls.name: Immutable Backup Architecture and RPO/RTO Validation
controls.gap_description: Mandates off-site immutable backup copies protected from ransomware.

controls.name: CERT-In 6-Hour Security Incident Reporting
controls.gap_description: Real-time alert correlation flags CERT-In reportable breaches with automated notification prep.
